data.explanation: The retailer says it has not received payment for an invoice that was due on 3 September 2026. It now asks for €94.99, which includes a €5.00 reminder fee, by 30 September 2026. If you already paid, you can treat the letter as void. If you haven't, pay to the IBAN given, using the invoice number as the reference. Otherwise the claim may go to a debt collection company, which adds costs. If you think the invoice or fee is wrong, contact the company in writing. Consumer advice centres can help.
